notes: 50 hand-written customer support emails across billing/technical/account/general, with deliberate edge cases (ambiguous, short, typo-laden, mixed-language, sarcastic) tagged by expected_difficulty. This is the ground truth the eval pipeline scores every prompt version against.

cases.input_email: I was charged $49.99 twice this month for the same subscription. Please refund the duplicate charge.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was double-charged for their subscription and wants a refund.
cases.notes: clear billing signal, keyword 'charged' + 'refund'

cases.input_email: My invoice from last week shows an incorrect tax amount. Can someone review it?
cases.expected_summary: Customer says their invoice has an incorrect tax amount and wants it reviewed.

cases.input_email: How do I update the credit card on file for my account?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to update the payment method on their account.
cases.notes: mentions 'account' but is a payment-method request, should be billing

cases.input_email: I canceled my plan in March but you're still billing me every month.
cases.expected_summary: Customer canceled their plan but is still being billed monthly.

cases.input_email: Can I get a copy of all my invoices from 2025 for tax purposes?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants copies of all their 2025 invoices for taxes.

cases.input_email: Why did my price go up from $9.99 to $14.99 without any notice?
cases.expected_summary: Customer's subscription price increased without notice and wants an explanation.

cases.input_email: refund pls charged wrong plan!!!
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants a refund because they were charged for the wrong plan.
cases.notes: extremely short, informal, typo-adjacent

cases.input_email: I'd like to switch from monthly to annual billing to save money.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to switch from monthly to annual billing.

cases.input_email: The app crashes every single time I try to upload a photo from my gallery.
cases.expected_summary: App crashes whenever the customer tries to upload a photo.

cases.input_email: Getting a 500 error whenever I try to submit the checkout form.
cases.expected_summary: Customer gets a 500 error when submitting the checkout form.

cases.input_email: The dashboard has been down for 2 hours, is there an outage?
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports the dashboard is down and asks about an outage.

cases.input_email: Your export feature produces a corrupted CSV file every time.
cases.expected_summary: The export feature produces a corrupted CSV file for the customer.

cases.input_email: app broken again lol third time this week
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports the app has broken for the third time this week.
cases.notes: sarcastic tone, informal, short

cases.input_email: The search bar stopped returning any results as of this morning.
cases.expected_summary: The search bar has stopped returning results since this morning.

cases.input_email: I keep getting logged out every few minutes, is this a bug?
cases.expected_summary: Customer keeps getting logged out every few minutes and asks if it's a bug.
cases.notes: mentions 'logged out' which overlaps with account category, but framed as a bug report

cases.input_email: Push notifications haven't worked on iOS since the last update.
cases.expected_summary: Push notifications have not worked on iOS since the last update.

cases.input_email: The mobile app freezes on the loading screen and never opens.
cases.expected_summary: The mobile app freezes on the loading screen and never opens.

cases.input_email: I can't remember my password and the reset email never arrives.
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot reset their password because the reset email isn't arriving.

cases.input_email: I'm locked out of my account after too many failed login attempts.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is locked out of their account after too many failed logins.

cases.input_email: How do I change the email address linked to my profile?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to change the email address linked to their profile.

cases.input_email: Please delete my account and all associated data permanently.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants their account and all data permanently deleted.

cases.input_email: I want to add my colleague as a second user on my account.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to add a colleague as a second user on their account.

cases.input_email: cant login, forgot username
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in because they forgot their username.
cases.notes: very short, no punctuation

cases.input_email: My two-factor authentication codes never arrive by SMS.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's two-factor authentication codes never arrive by SMS.
cases.notes: could be read as technical, ground truth is account since it's login/security related

cases.input_email: Someone else seems to have accessed my account, can you check the login history?
cases.expected_summary: Customer suspects unauthorized access and wants their login history checked.

cases.input_email: Do you offer a student discount for this product?
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether a student discount is available.
cases.notes: touches pricing but is a general inquiry, not a billing issue

cases.input_email: Do you have a mobile app for Android?
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether an Android app exists.

cases.input_email: What are your customer support hours on weekends?
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking about weekend customer support hours.

cases.input_email: I love the new update, great work team!
cases.expected_summary: Customer is giving positive feedback about the new update.

cases.input_email: Do you integrate with Salesforce?
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether the product integrates with Salesforce.

cases.input_email: Could you point me to your API documentation?
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking where to find the API documentation.

cases.input_email: oh great, ANOTHER charge I didn't approve. love that for me.
cases.expected_summary: Customer sarcastically complains about another unapproved charge.
cases.notes: sarcasm, informal punctuation

cases.input_email: no puedo iniciar sesion, la contrasena no funciona
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in because their password isn't working.
cases.notes: mixed language (Spanish), login/password issue

cases.input_email: L'application plante a chaque fois que j'essaie d'exporter mes donnees.
cases.expected_summary: The application crashes every time the customer tries to export their data.
cases.notes: mixed language (French), crash/export bug

cases.input_email: billing question but also the app crashed twice today, which team handles this?
cases.expected_summary: Customer has a billing question but also mentions the app crashed twice today.
cases.notes: genuinely ambiguous between billing and technical, ground truth picks the stated primary intent

cases.input_email: hey
cases.expected_summary: Customer sent a greeting with no further context.
cases.notes: extremely short, no signal at all

cases.input_email: Refund? Account locked? Bug? Not sure who to even ask at this point.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is unsure which team to contact for a mix of issues.
cases.notes: mentions all three keyword groups, ground truth is general because no single issue is committed to

cases.input_email: I'd like a receipt emailed to me for my last purchase, please.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants a receipt emailed for their last purchase.

cases.input_email: Every time I hit save, the page just spins forever.
cases.expected_summary: The page spins indefinitely whenever the customer hits save.
cases.notes: no explicit keyword like 'bug' or 'crash', tests general fault description

cases.input_email: Please remove my old shipping address and add a new one.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to update their shipping address on file.
cases.notes: profile/account data change, no login keywords

cases.input_email: What time zone do your live webinars run in?
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking what time zone the live webinars run in.

cases.input_email: I was billed in USD but expected EUR based on my region, why?
cases.expected_summary: Customer was billed in USD instead of the expected EUR for their region.

cases.input_email: video calls keep dropping after ~5 min, happens on wifi and mobile data
cases.expected_summary: Video calls keep dropping after about five minutes on both wifi and mobile data.
cases.notes: no punctuation, casual tone

cases.input_email: wya with my refund its been 2 weeks
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking where their refund is after two weeks.
cases.notes: slang abbreviation 'wya', very short

cases.input_email: Not a complaint, just wondering if you plan to support dark mode soon?
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether dark mode support is planned.
cases.notes: feature request, not a bug report

cases.input_email: My subscription renewed at the old price even though I upgraded my plan.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's subscription renewed at the old price despite upgrading their plan.

cases.input_email: The login page just shows a blank white screen now.
cases.expected_summary: The login page shows a blank white screen.
cases.notes: mentions 'login' but is clearly a rendering bug, tests keyword-vs-intent confusion

cases.input_email: Can I merge two accounts I accidentally created into one?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to merge two accidentally created accounts into one.

cases.input_email: Just wanted to say thanks, your support team resolved my issue fast yesterday.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is thanking the support team for resolving an issue quickly.

cases.input_email: billing address wrong on invoice AND cant reset my password, ugh
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports a wrong billing address on their invoice and a password reset problem.
cases.notes: two distinct issues in one email, ground truth picks the first-stated issue (billing)
